**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, author a.novak, "connection-per-request for pool isolation") flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. That made every request grab its own DB connection instead of reusing the pool, so the pool (size 20) maxed out and stopped releasing.

**Impact window:** Started 2026-03-14 02:14:18Z (19s after the deploy finished at 02:14:00Z). Still ongoing as of the last log line, 03:59:27Z. Error is `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, 530 occurrences, same message each time, `waiting` queue climbing (13 → 74+) with no recovery.

**Scope:** Gateway only. `worker.log` for the same window shows jobs finishing normally, only one unrelated pre-existing `WARN` (slow query, OPS-2210).

**Action:** Roll back `dep-4471` — revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`.
